title: default record page: three sibling remedy texts still say "compose the deployment without the package" after #23310 reworded the registry's; AppPlugin.bundle has an undeclared reader
body:
Filing gate ③: follow-ups named by a contract review. PR #23550 (#23310) rewords `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT`'s remedy in `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` generically ("…or compose the deployment without the other package's page"), and makes `os serve` / `DevPlugin` leave out `plugin-auth`'s `sys_organization` page when the app declares its own. Its contract record (on PR #23550, ①.1 and ①.6) judged three sibling texts and one coupling as follow-ups, not must-fixes. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 (#18883) · `baozhoutao` · session `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz`. ⛔ Not a claim; lane and grade are triage's.

`reach:` an author (or an AI) who meets a default-record-page conflict through the metadata save door or reads `PageSchema.isDefault`'s TSDoc: the remedy still prescribes dropping a whole package, which a host can now avoid by leaving out the page (PR #23309's option; #23310's derivation).

**Reader who acts:** triage, to grade and route.

## What still reads the old way (at PR #23550's head `c2db30e78`)

1. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `saveMetaItem`'s remedy (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, ~21275): "a page a package ships stays the default unless the deployment is composed without that package". It is pinned verbatim by `default-record-page-save-door.test.ts:191`.
2. `PageSchema.isDefault` TSDoc (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts:1670–1672`): "…or compose the deployment without the package that ships the other." Author-facing published prose.
3. `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts:919–920`, a source comment: "composing the deployment without the other package".

Each is still true of one path, but none names the narrower step. The ask is the same generic rewording the registry got (no option, no package, no tracker number), with the save-door pin moved in the same round.

## The coupling

`stackDeclaresOrganizationRecordPage` (`packages/core/src/stack-organization-record-page.ts`, new in PR #23550) reads `AppPlugin`'s `bundle`, which `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts:152` declares `private bundle: any`. The read is structural and works today; on both roots the stack itself is also passed, so the config boot's answer does not depend on it. The ask is a public readonly accessor on `AppPlugin`, or a comment on the field naming this reader.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, query `DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT remedy compose the deployment without the package saveMetaItem isDefault TSDoc`: 11 hits. #23310 is the parent card; #23213, #23165, #22128, #22591 and the rest are closed and about other questions. None covers these three texts.
